move: phone turns in 3D, headline rises, screens swipe, ring counts, turns out
how: Over a slowly scaling sunset background (scale 1.05->1.1, xPercent -1->1, linear over full duration) a 300x620 phone fromTo's rotateY -55->-14, x 260->0, opacity 0->1 in the first 16% with expo.out, then breathes rotateY -14->-8->-16 and y -10/6 with two 3s sine.inOut segments. Left headline words rise from yPercent 110 inside overflow-hidden spans (0.1s stagger, expo.out) followed by the paragraph and a pill button (back.out). Inside the screen, page-1 cards rise from y:40, two checkboxes fill pink and scale-pop 1.3 yoyo at 24% and 30%; at 37% the .pages strip slides xPercent -33.3 (expo.inOut), tab dots recolour, a progress ring draws drawSVG 0->82% while a percentage counter climbs (power3.out); at 67% the strip slides to -66.6% and list rows stagger in from x:30. At 92% the phone rotates rotateY 50, x 300, opacity 0 with expo.in and the copy slides left and fades.
adapt: Change the three headline words, paragraph, button label, page headings, hero gradient and accent (#ff3d81), the ring target percentage and the background image. Keep the 1.3s move entry, the 0.7s expo.inOut page swipes and the exit at 0.92 of the duration.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the copy block and the phone with its three-page strip from shot strings; animate(el, shot, D) returns one GSAP timeline with the positions expressed as fractions of D (entry 0-0.16D, swipes at 0.375D and 0.675D, exit at 0.925D). The counter onUpdate must target el.querySelector('.pct') rather than document; the bg image URL must come from shot assets.
caveats: from() tweens without immediateRender:false on page-2/3 elements; safe only because they are behind the strip until their swipe
loop does not close: phone exits right and copy fades
